findings.text: The Code Node CN-156 names core/tools/transcribe.py#Stop (line 64), an exception class whose only method is its constructor. rcf-lite 0.42.0 mutates a class through its methods other than __init__, so this node has no mutable symbol and the strength proof cannot judge it, for this criterion and for AC-1702-1, which the node also names. Closed by removing the node through the tool; both criteria keep their nodes on Engine, readable, one and main.

The Code Node CN-064 (installer/Squire.app/Contents/MacOS/Squire#sq_yes_text, line 427) gained AC-1702-1 in this build. Its file has no extension, which rcf-lite 0.42.0 reads as an unsupported file type, so the strength proof of the voice-note criterion becomes blocked instead of judged. The one change to that function (line 434, the one-yes words naming the voice notes job) serves the install criterion AC-1901-5, which the node already names. Closed by removing AC-1702-1 from CN-064 through the tool.

tests/acceptance/video-and-audio.test.js line 223 (a captions origin that is not the loopback of this Mac is never asked) still passes when core/tools/captions.py origin_of (lines 106 to 115) honours any origin: each origin the case names ends in .invalid and never resolves, and the reader connects directly with no proxy, so neither the YouTube stand-in nor the network recorder can see the attempt. A red test names an origin off the loopback that does answer on this Mac (the stand-in reached through the network address of this Mac, as the off-Mac pages case does) and asserts that the stand-in records no request and nothing is kept. Hosted CI at aee56d7: runs 43986954792 (push) and 43986964414 (pull request) were in progress when this verdict was recorded.
